the measurement, verification and quantification of the impact of ECMs in irrigation pumping.

the developed M&V methodology and tools are suitable for measuring the impacts of ECMs under Eskom’s Standard Product Programme.

the developed M&V methodology is a practical, cost-effective, reliable and robust tool to quantify ECM impacts in irrigation pumping.
